dolphin.notes: Main system (Config::System::Main): [Core], [DSP], [General], [Interface], [Display], [Android], [Analytics]... Only keys that were ever set are present; a missing key means the source default.

gcpad.notes: GameCube controller mappings, [GCPad1]..[GCPad4]. Values are ControllerInterface expressions (backticks quote control names).

retroachievements.notes: Achievements system. Holds the API token after sign-in: never print it.

timeplayed.notes: [TimePlayed] <GameID> = hex milliseconds. Written by Dolphin when emulation stops. Read-only for adapters.

game_user.notes: User per-game overrides (LocalGame layer). Uses legacy section names, see per_game.notes.

game_sys.notes: Built-in per-game defaults shipped in the APK (GlobalGame layer, 1883 files in 2609b). Re-extracted on app update: never edit; override in game_user instead.

android_prefs.notes: Android-only UI state (touch overlay button positions etc.). Not emulation settings.

per_game.game_id: 6-character disc ID (e.g. GZ2E01). RVZ/WIA: bytes at file offset 0x58; CISO: offset 0x8000; ISO/GCM: offset 0. Also listed in Config/TimePlayed.ini and in the first comment line of the Sys GameSettings file.
per_game.notes: Layering, lowest to highest: Base (Config/*.ini) < GlobalGame (Sys/GameSettings) < LocalGame (User GameSettings) < Movie < Netplay < CurrentRun. Within each game layer the files loaded are <first letter>.ini, <first 3 chars>.ini, <ID>.ini, <ID>r<revision>.ini (later wins). Section map: Dolphin.ini [Core]->[Core], [DSP]->[DSP], [Display]->[Display]; GFX.ini [Hardware]->[Video_Hardware], [Settings]->[Video_Settings], [Enhancements]->[Video_Enhancements], [Hacks]->[Video_Hacks], [Stereoscopy]->[Video_Stereoscopy]; any other setting as [<System>.<Section>] (e.g. [Main.General]). Controller mappings (GCPad/WiiPad/GCKeyboard) are not saveable per game except Wiimote sources. Read on each game boot.

video_backend.label: Video Backend
video_backend.notes: Default is the first available backend (VideoBackendBase::GetAvailableBackends): OGL on Android. Lives in Dolphin.ini, not GFX.ini. Per-game: [Core] GFXBackend in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

internal_resolution.label: Internal Resolution
internal_resolution.notes: Android UI offers 1-6. Core accepts up to MaxInternalResolution (default 12); 0 = Auto (window size) on desktop builds. Per-game: [Video_Settings] InternalResolution in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

shader_compilation_mode.label: Shader Compilation Mode

values.0: Specialized (Default): ubershaders never used; stutter while compiling, low GPU cost
values.1: Exclusive Ubershaders: always ubershaders; near stutter-free, very high GPU cost
values.2: Hybrid Ubershaders: ubershaders until specialized shaders compile
values.3: Skip Drawing: skip objects whose shaders are compiling (asynchronous)

shader_compilation_mode.notes: enum ShaderCompilationMode {Synchronous, SynchronousUberShaders, AsynchronousUberShaders, AsynchronousSkipRendering}. Per-game: [Video_Settings] ShaderCompilationMode in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

values.True: compile cached shaders before the game starts

vsync.label: V-Sync
vsync.notes: Android UI: unnecessary on most Android devices because Android always enables V-Sync. Per-game: [Video_Hardware] VSync in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

aspect_ratio.label: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.notes: enum AspectMode {Auto, ForceWide, ForceStandard, Stretch, Custom, CustomStretch, Raw}. Android UI offers 0-3. Per-game: [Video_Settings] AspectRatio in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

widescreen_hack.label: Widescreen Hack

values.True: force game to render for any aspect ratio

widescreen_hack.notes: Key is lower-case "wideScreenHack". Use with aspect_ratio=1 to force 16:9. Often breaks HUDs. Per-game: [Video_Settings] wideScreenHack in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

msaa.label: Full-scene Anti-aliasing
msaa.notes: Sample count. With ssaa=True the same count is used as SSAA. Per-game: [Video_Settings] MSAA in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

ssaa.label: SSAA (desktop: "Anti-Aliasing: SSAA")
ssaa.notes: Not exposed in the Android UI; the core reads it. Per-game: [Video_Settings] SSAA in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

anisotropic_filtering.label: Anisotropic Filtering
anisotropic_filtering.notes: Source enum AnisotropicFilteringMode {Default=-1, Force1x=0, Force2x=1, Force4x=2, Force8x=3, Force16x=4}. The Android UI array (2609b) still labels 0 as "Default", 1-4 as 2x-16x, so the UI shows 0 as Default although the core treats 0 as forced 1x. Per-game: [Video_Enhancements] MaxAnisotropy in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

post_processing_shader.label: Post-Processing Effect

values.<name>: any Sys/Shaders/<name>.glsl or User Shaders/<name>.glsl, name without .glsl

post_processing_shader.notes: Shader list on device: /data/data/org.dolphinemu.dolphinemu/files/Sys/Shaders/*.glsl (FXAA, 16bit, 32bit, sepia, grayscale, ...). Anaglyph/Passive subfolders are for stereo modes. Per-game: [Video_Enhancements] PostProcessingShader in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

skip_efb_access.label: Skip EFB Access from CPU (inverted)

values.False: skip CPU EFB reads/writes (UI toggle ON)
values.True: allow CPU EFB access (UI toggle OFF, accurate)

skip_efb_access.notes: UI shows the inverse of the stored value. Per-game: [Video_Hacks] EFBAccessEnable in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

store_efb_copies_to_texture.label: Store EFB Copies to Texture Only

values.True: keep EFB copies on GPU only (fast)
values.False: also write EFB copies to RAM (accurate)

defer_efb_copies.label: Defer EFB Copies to RAM

values.True: defer writing EFB copies until the game syncs

defer_efb_copies.notes: Source default True; Android description says "If unsure, leave this unchecked". Per-game: [Video_Hacks] DeferEFBCopies in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

values.True: present XFB copies immediately (lower latency, some glitches)
round vertices to pixel grid (fixes some upscaling seams)

disable_bbox.label: Disable Bounding Box (inverted)

values.True: bounding box emulated (UI toggle OFF; needed by Paper Mario TTYD, Super Paper Mario)

disable_bbox.notes: UI shows the inverse of the stored value. Per-game: [Video_Hacks] BBoxEnable in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

custom_textures.label: Load Custom Textures
custom_textures.notes: Texture packs go in /sdcard/Android/data/org.dolphinemu.dolphinemu/files/Load/Textures/<GameID>/. Per-game: [Video_Settings] HiresTextures in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

gpu_driver.label: GPU Driver

values.<name>: custom Vulkan driver installed under files/GPUDrivers (Turnip etc.)

gpu_driver.notes: Android custom driver loader. Device has /data/data/org.dolphinemu.dolphinemu/files/GPUDrivers/. Install drivers through the app; the value must match an installed driver.

cpu_core.label: CPU Core
cpu_core.notes: enum PowerPC::CPUCore {Interpreter=0, JIT64=1, JITARM64=4, CachedInterpreter=5}; default DefaultCPUCore() = 4 on arm64. Per-game: [Core] CPUCore in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

dual_core.label: Dual Core (speedhack)

values.True: CPU and GPU on separate threads

dual_core.notes: Default True on Android (DEFAULT_CPU_THREAD), False on desktop. Per-game: [Core] CPUThread in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

sync_gpu.label: Synchronize GPU Thread (part 1 of 2)
sync_gpu.notes: UI "Synchronize GPU Thread" is a 3-way choice over two keys: Never = SyncGPU False + SyncOnSkipIdle False; On Idle Skipping = SyncGPU False + SyncOnSkipIdle True (default); Always = SyncGPU True + SyncOnSkipIdle True. Per-game: [Core] SyncGPU in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

sync_on_skip_idle.label: Synchronize GPU Thread (part 2 of 2)
sync_on_skip_idle.notes: See sync_gpu. Per-game: [Core] SyncOnSkipIdle in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

cpu_overclock.label: Emulated CPU Clock Speed
cpu_overclock.notes: Only used when cpu_overclock_enable=True. Dolphin writes floats with fmt "{:#}"; any decimal string such as 1.5 parses. Per-game: [Core] Overclock in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

values.True: emulate MMU (some games need it, slower)

values.<float>: fraction of full speed; UI slider 0-200% (0.5 = 50%)

dsp_hle.label: DSP Emulation Engine (part 1 of 2)

values.False: DSP LLE (recompiler or interpreter, chosen by DSP/EnableJIT)

dsp_hle.notes: UI choice maps to two keys: HLE = DSPHLE True; LLE Recompiler = DSPHLE False + [DSP] EnableJIT True; LLE Interpreter = DSPHLE False + [DSP] EnableJIT False. Per-game: [Core] DSPHLE in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

audio_backend.label: Audio Backend
audio_backend.notes: Not shown in Android 2609b settings UI (MAIN_AUDIO_BACKEND not in SettingsFragmentPresenter). "Audio stretching" no longer exists: replaced by fill_audio_gaps / preserve_audio_pitch. Per-game: [DSP] Backend in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.

dsp_thread.label: DSP LLE on Thread

values.True: run DSP LLE on its own thread

dsp_thread.notes: Only matters with DSP LLE. Per-game: [DSP] DSPThread in GameSettings/<ID>.ini.
